description: Up to four editorial event spotlights; Doom automatically becomes the lead slide from 1 December 2026 to 28 February 2027. Comic reading continues through installed sources. Check the edition and listed issue numbers.

events.title: MARVEL MIDNIGHT
events.label: THE MIDNIGHT UNIVERSE
events.summary: A terrifying new Marvel Universe reimagines familiar heroes through a darker, horror-infused lens. Three interconnected series launched together on 7 October 2026: Midnight X-Men, Midnight Spider-Man and Midnight Fantastic Four.

series.title: Midnight X-Men
series.tagline: The X-Men fight to survive a terrifying new Marvel world.

series.title: Midnight Spider-Man
series.tagline: A dark and unsettling transformation of Spider-Man.

series.title: Midnight Fantastic Four
series.tagline: Marvel's First Family faces a twisted new reality.

events.title: DC ABSOLUTE UNIVERSE
events.label: DC ALL IN
events.summary: DC's Absolute Universe reinvents familiar superheroes in a world of new origins and dangers. Explore the main Batman, Superman and Wonder Woman titles, then the expanded line including Flash, Green Lantern, Martian Manhunter, Green Arrow and Catwoman.

series.title: Absolute Batman
series.tagline: A radically reimagined Dark Knight.

series.title: Absolute Superman
series.tagline: A different world for the Man of Steel.

series.title: Absolute Wonder Woman
series.tagline: Diana enters the Absolute Universe.

series.title: Absolute Flash
series.tagline: The Scarlet Speedster, reinvented.

series.title: Absolute Green Lantern
series.tagline: A new light and an unsettling mystery.

series.title: Absolute Martian Manhunter
series.tagline: A visionary science-fiction take on J'onn.

series.title: Absolute Green Arrow
series.tagline: A dark murder mystery set in the Absolute world.

series.title: Absolute Catwoman
series.tagline: Selina Kyle joins the growing Absolute line.

events.title: ULTIMATE UNIVERSE
events.label: MARVEL'S NEW ULTIMATE ERA
events.summary: Marvel's modern Ultimate Universe began with new versions of Spider-Man, Black Panther, the X-Men and the Ultimates. Follow their connected stories and the return of the Maker through Ultimate Endgame and Ultimate Universe: Finale.

series.title: Ultimate Spider-Man
series.tagline: Peter Parker starts an extraordinary new life.

series.title: Ultimate Black Panther
series.tagline: A bold new story for Wakanda.

series.title: Ultimate X-Men
series.tagline: An unsettling new take on the X-Men.

series.title: The Ultimates
series.tagline: The heroes of this new universe assemble.

series.title: Ultimate Wolverine
series.tagline: A dangerous new beginning for Wolverine.

series.title: Ultimate Endgame
series.tagline: The Maker returns for a climactic showdown.

series.title: Ultimate Universe: Finale
series.tagline: The conclusion of the modern Ultimate saga.

events.title: DOCTOR DOOM
events.label: DOOMSDAY · ESSENTIAL READING
events.summary: Before Marvel Studios' Avengers: Doomsday reaches UK cinemas on 16 December 2026, discover Victor von Doom: the brilliant ruler of Latveria, scientific genius and master of sorcery. This editorial reading path begins with his origin, follows his rivalry with the Fantastic Four and his rise to cosmic power, then ends with One World Under Doom. These comics are recommended background, not a confirmed movie plot.

series.title: Books of Doom
series.tagline: START HERE: Doom recounts his own origin and rise in Latveria.

series.title: Fantastic Four
series.tagline: Doctor Doom's original first appearance, by Lee and Kirby.

series.title: Marvel Super-Heroes Secret Wars
series.tagline: Doom's hunger for power takes centre stage in the original event.

series.title: Emperor Doom
series.tagline: What happens when Doom successfully conquers the entire Earth?

series.title: Doctor Strange & Doctor Doom: Triumph and Torment
aliases: Doctor Strange and Doctor Doom: Triumph and Torment
series.tagline: Doom confronts the mystical bargain involving his mother's soul.

series.title: Doomwar
series.tagline: Doom targets Wakanda and brings Black Panther into the conflict.

series.title: Secret Wars
series.tagline: God Emperor Doom rules the fractured remains of the multiverse.

series.title: Infamous Iron Man
series.tagline: After Secret Wars, Doom makes an unsettling attempt at heroism.

series.title: Doctor Doom
series.tagline: A solo political and sci-fi thriller through Doom's perspective.

series.title: One World Under Doom
series.tagline: READ LAST: As Sorcerer Supreme, Doom declares himself emperor of Earth.
